### Smarter bank campaign targeting
The highest-scoring 10% of test records contained about 45% of subscribers. A classification study built around campaign capacity, class imbalance, and honest evaluation.

::: {.project-card}
<span class="tag">Business operations</span> <span class="tag">Experience</span>

### Sales costing & reconciliation
At ALFA STORE, I developed a digital tool to reduce repetitive sales calculations and support daily reconciliation, reporting an approximately 80% reduction in calculation time.

[Read the experience summary →](projects/sales-reconciliation.qmd){.project-link}
:::
::: {.project-card}
<span class="tag">Applied economics</span> <span class="tag">Research</span>

### Healthcare spending & household welfare
Research using household survey data, Python, and Stata to examine out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure and household welfare in Nigeria.

[Explore my research →](research.qmd){.project-link}

## A quantitative foundation. A practical focus.

My experience spans economic research, sales records, workflow improvement, and academic mentorship. I bring that context to data work: start with a useful question, validate the data, and make the result understandable.

**Tools:** Python · Pandas · NumPy · SQL/MySQL · Excel · Stata · EViews · R
